description.text: This program is to help student gain knowledge and ability of business management, economic management and enterprise management, and enable student to deal with all kinds of business management related work in all kinds of organizations.Major Courses:Principles of Management,micro-economics,macro-economics,Management Information System,Statistics, Accounting, Finance Management, Marketing,Economic Law,Human Resource Management,Enterprise Strategic Management"

duration.text: The Business Management at Shandong University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months)Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo includedPassport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicantHigh school academic transcriptHigh school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English.Resume Written in Chinese or in English

requirements.text: Abide by Chinese Laws, under 40 of age; a good command of English; in good health; with reliable financial support and custody.
